tips.1: Fill the ULT meter and press Ultimate - then strike your fighter's pose on camera before the countdown ends.
tips.2: Higher DEF shaves damage off every hit and makes your block stronger.
tips.3: Good posture tracked by the camera earns bonus coins after each match.
tips.4: Skins and weapons are cosmetic only - stats never change with what a fighter wears.
tips.5: In Training, press T to fill your ultimate. The dummy always gets back up.
tips.6: Every fighter brings one of two passives - choose it in the loadout panel after locking in.
tips.7: Online fights use rollback netcode: both games run the same fight from the same inputs.

settings.keys_help:
Click a binding, then press a key or click that box with a mouse button (Esc / pad B / a click elsewhere cancels; 5 s timeout). If either player already uses it, the two swap.
Camera poses are for the ultimate only: with a full meter, hold your fighter's pose for half a second (cross arms, arm out to the side, or both hands up; keyboard poses: 1/2/3 and 8/9/0).
play.four_player_later: 2v2 and Battle Royale arrive with 4-player support in a later update.

class.kaia.skill1_desc: Dash forward and thrust into the opponent
class.kaia.ult_desc: 10s: normal attacks unleash a horizontal wave
class.bruna.skill1_desc: Grab the opponent and smash them on the ground
class.bruna.skill2_desc: Spin like a tornado, hitting repeatedly
class.bruna.ult_desc: Smash the floor to create a shockwave
class.ren.skill2_desc: Strangle a close opponent and push them away
class.ren.ult_desc: One arrow multiplies into a storm of arrows
class.lyra.passive1_desc: 10% chance on hit: -15% move, -10% dmg, -15% atk speed
class.lyra.skill3_desc: A cloud follows the foe and strikes with thunder
class.lyra.ult_desc: 10s ring of fire: burns foes, blocks projectiles
class.taro.skill2_desc: Spin the polearm to block projectiles
class.taro.skill3_desc: Throw the spear and call it back
class.taro.ult_desc: Stab the foe, then kick the handle in deeper
char.kaia.style: Fast, mobile close-range combat with precise, chainable slashes.
char.bruna.style: High-damage, high-durability brawler that controls space with weighty attacks.
char.ren.style: High-mobility zoning and precision pressure with versatile arrow tech.
char.lyra.style: Agile spellcaster who controls space with fast casts, tricky mobility and precise magic.
char.taro.style: Disciplined, mobile control with long-reach pressure and precise strikes.
